details: Hotter-than-expected US inflation data for September, coming in at 3.7% against a 3.6% forecast, led to a decline in Bitcoin's price by $1,000, bringing it to approximately $81,600. This data has heightened concerns about potential Federal Reserve interest rate hikes.
title: US Inflation Exceeds Forecast, Bitcoin Dips Below $83K

details: South Korea's Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) has taken action to block access to 27 foreign cryptocurrency exchanges operating without proper registration, including major platforms like KuCoin and MEXC. This move highlights increasing regulatory scrutiny and poses access concerns for existing users in the region.
title: South Korea Blocks Access to KuCoin and 26 Other Crypto Exchanges

details: Ripple has announced a partnership with Stripe-owned Privy to integrate embedded wallet solutions directly into the XRP Ledger. This collaboration aims to enhance the accessibility and user experience of XRP by streamlining wallet functionalities within applications.
title: Ripple Partners With Stripe's Privy for XRP Ledger Embedded Wallets

details: EasyA, a platform dedicated to fostering the development of blockchain and artificial intelligence applications, has achieved a valuation of $1.1 billion. The company's co-founder and CEO has indicated plans for a direct public listing in the first half of 2027.
title: EasyA, Blockchain/AI Dev Platform, Valued at $1.1B, Targets 2027 IPO

details: Ledger has requested its resellers across seven Asian markets to withdraw devices from sale following the discovery of a suspected hardware implant in a wallet sold by a Southeast Asian reseller, CryptoBilis. Ledger's security team identified that the implant could compromise users' 24-word recovery phrases.
title: Ledger Wallets Pulled in Asia After Suspected $86M Security Drain
